events.verdict: Poeltl (TOR) rolls toward the basket and briefly engages with Stewart (DET) before disengaging.
Stewart (DET) establishes screening position in Battle's (DET) path and does not deliver contact.

Beasley (DET) reaches for the ball and marginal contact occurs with Barnes' (TOR) face. Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Stewart (DET) moves alongside Mitchell's (TOR) path and marginal body contact occurs during the driving shot attempt.
Poeltl (TOR) and Harris (DET) reach for the loose ball and marginal arm contact occurs with Harris before Stewart (DET) secures the rebound.
Poeltl (TOR) is attempting to establish screening position in Harris' (DET) path and the two briefly engage and disengage before Poeltl turns to roll.
Stewart (DET) jumps alongside Barnes' (TOR) path and absorbs the marginal body contact that occurs during the driving shot attempt.
Battle (TOR) and Stewart (DET) come together in pursuit of the loose ball and marginal body contact occurs during the rebound.
Barnes (TOR) and Stewart (DET) pursue the loose ball and marginal arm to arm contact occurs during the rebound.
Barrett (TOR) lifts his arm into Harris (DET) as he is retreating his arm into a vertical position and the contact during his driving shot attempt is marginal.
Poeltl (TOR) brings two hands toward Harris (DET) during the pick before releasing away to roll and marginal contact occurs.
Harris (DET) moves alongside Barnes (TOR) before establishing himself in front of Barnes' path and absorbing the marginal body contact that occurs during the driving shot attempt.
Agbaji (TOR) briefly rests a forearm on Ivey's (DET) side before retracting it as Ivey gathers.
